title: Power Rangers Season 26 Beast Morphers
description: A secret agency creates a new team of Power Rangers by combining a recently identified substance with animal DNA. Soon, the Rangers are tasked with defeating a computer virus from another dimension.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x1
episodes_data.description: Scientists tap into the Morphin Grid, but an evil virus corrupts the technology and a new team of Power Rangers is formed to defend the Grid from evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x2
episodes_data.description: When Grid Battleforce’s Commander needs to select a leader for the team, the Power Rangers are at odds over who should get the job.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x3
episodes_data.description: Zoey tries to convince the citizens of Coral Harbor to use Morph-X powered bikes instead of cars, but Blaze uses the opportunity to execute an evil plan.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x4
episodes_data.description: Ravi is shocked when the evil Roxy comes to his rescue and wonders if there may still be good left in her.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x5
episodes_data.description: Devon finds it difficult to balance a new job he took to impress his dad and the duties of being the Red Power Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x6
episodes_data.description: Nate develops new technology from a captured Gigadrone and Devon struggles with fully trusting his team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x7
episodes_data.description: Evox targets the Beast Bots to stop the Rangers from forming their Megazord.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x8
episodes_data.description: Scrozzle executes his plan to finally free Evox from the Cyber Dimension and the Rangers, along with an unexpected friend, must do everything in their power to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x9
episodes_data.description: The Rangers must band together to save one of their own from Evox's new plan.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x10
episodes_data.description: Ravi must face one of his worst fears when it interferes with his Ranger duties.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x11
episodes_data.description: An innocent lie leads to a break in trust between the Power Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x12
episodes_data.description: When Nate and Steel unexpectedly clash, it leads to double trouble for the team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x13
episodes_data.description: After witnessing a boy being bullied, Ravi takes him under his wing.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x14
episodes_data.description: The Rangers are hypnotized into believing that they are the characters they dressed up as for Halloween.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x15
episodes_data.description: The Rangers' skills are put to the test when Blaze uses evil tech to massively enhance his Robotron's destructive power.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x16
episodes_data.description: The Red Ranger gets amazing new powers, but they have unexpected side effects.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x17
episodes_data.description: Ravi resorts to drastic measures when Smash accidentally discovers a closely guarded secret.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x18
episodes_data.description: When a movie star comes to town, the Rangers' secret identities are unexpectedly threatened.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x19
episodes_data.description: The Rangers are brainwashed to think that Blaze and Roxy are part of their team.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x20
episodes_data.description: Evox and his minions hatch the ultimate plan to take over the Morphin Grid.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x21
episodes_data.description: The Rangers mount a desperate mission to stop Evox once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers Beast Morphers 26x22
episodes_data.description: When the Rangers get trapped inside holiday ornaments, their Beast Bots must save both the Rangers and the city.
